verdict.rationale: Polar publishes llms.txt both at polar.sh/llms.txt and in its docs, and a probe confirmed the root file returns HTTP 200. Docs pages have `.md` siblings, which the many `.md` doc URLs in the pack corroborate, and versioned OpenAPI specs are served from the docs site, giving agents machine-legible documentation. The root `docs.md` path returned 404, but that does not contradict the per-page `.md` siblings. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated single-file docs export, and no independent hands-on report of an agent consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: polar.sh/docs publishes llms.txt with `.md` siblings for every page
